PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLY OF BALOCHISTAN RULES OF PROCEDURE AND CONDUCT OF
BUSINESS, 1974
PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLY OF BALOCHISTAN RULES OF
PROCEDURE AND CONDUCT OF BUSINESS, 1974
(Insertion of sub-rules 4 and 5 in R.135)
[Gazette of Balochistan
Extraordinary,
29th March, 2017]
No.
PAB/Legis:I(03)/2013/8346, dated 29.3.2017.---Provincial Assembly of Balochistan at its sitting held on 7th March,
2017 passed the following amendments in the Provincial Assembly of Balochistan
Rules of Procedure and Conduct of Business, 1974.
In
Rule 135 after sub-rule 3, the following new sub-rules 4 and 5 shall be
inserted namely:-
Power to appoint
sub-committees.
4. A Committee may,
with the approval of the Speaker, appoint a sub-committee for a specified
function arising out of the matter referred to the committee.
5. The order of
reference to a sub-committee shall clearly state the point for investigation.
The report of the sub-committee shall be considered by the whole committee
and when approved by the whole Committee, be deemed to be the report of that
Committee.
Provided that the
sub-committee shall stand dissolved at the expiry of two months irrespective
of presentation of the report.
